content.title: Michael B. Jordan Powerfully Accepts Best Actor Oscar for Sinners: 'I Stand Here Because of the People That Came Before Me'
content.text: "Thank you, everybody in this room and everybody at home for supporting me over my career," he said Updated on March 15, 2026 11:16PM EDT0 seconds of 1 minute, 12 secondsVolume 0% NEED TO KNOW Michael B. Jordan won the Academy Award for Best Actor at the 2026 Oscars, beating Leonardo DiCaprio, Ethan Hawke, Timothée Chalamet and Wagner MouraIt was the first nomination for Jordan, who played twins Smoke and Stack in Sinners, and he thanked his female leads Wunmi Mosaku and Hailee Steinfeld"Thank you, everybody in this room and everybody at home for supporting me over my career. I feel it," he said Michael B. Jordan gave a poignant speech after winning the Academy Award for Best Actor on Sunday night at the 2026 Oscars. The actor, 39, who took home the Oscar for playing twin brothers Smoke and Stack in Sinners, started off his speech by thanking his family as well as his Sinners director and frequent collaborator Ryan Coogler, who won earlier in the night for Best Original Screenplay. He then turned his attention to his two leading ladies in the film, Wunmi Mosaku and Hailee Steinfeld. "Wunmi, thank you so much for giving Smoke an opportunity to be him," Jordan said. "Hailee at home — you know she's getting ready to have a baby right now — thank you so much for being the other half of Stack." Michael B Jordan. Patrick T. Fallon / AFP via Getty Jordan then thanked the Black actors and actress who previously won lead acting Oscars. "I stand here because of the people that came before me: Sidney Poitier, Denzel Washington, Halle Berry, Jamie Foxx, Forrest Whitaker, Will Smith," Jordan said onstage. "And to be amongst those giants, amongst those great greats, amongst my ancestors, amongst my guys." Related Stories Jordan closed out by thanking those who have have encouraged him over the years. "Thank you, everybody in this room and everybody at home for supporting me over my career. I feel it. I know you guys want me to do well, and I want to do that because you guys bet on me," Jordan said. Jordan as twins Smke and Stack in 'Sinners'. Warner Bros. Jordan was nominated alongside an impressive list of actors that included former winner Leonardo DiCaprio (One Battle After Another), Wagner Moura (The Secret Agent) and a pair of three-time acting nominees, Ethan Hawke (Blue Moon) and Timothee Chalamet (Marty Supreme). Chalamet appeared to be the early frontrunner in the category after winning at the Golden Globe Awards and Critics' Choice Awards earlier this year, but lost out to Jordan at The Actor Awards and I Swear star Robert Aramayo at the BAFTA Film Awards See PEOPLE's coverage of the 98th Academy Awards, airing live on ABC and Hulu on March 15
